title: 微信预约提醒
WeChat reservation alerts
intro: 新预约和顾客取消预约时提醒你，关闭网站后仍会发送。
Receive alerts for new reservations and customer cancellations, even when the website is closed.
get_key: 打开 Server 酱，扫码登录并获取 SendKey
Open ServerChan, sign in and get your SendKey
key_help: 填写 SCT 开头的密钥。已保存时留空即可保留；密钥不会显示在发送记录中。
Use the key beginning with SCT. Leave blank to keep a saved key. It will not appear in the activity log.
quota_help: 按最近 24 小时控制发送次数，请按实际账号选择。这里的选择不会开通付费会员。
Sending is limited over the last 24 hours. Select your actual account allowance; this does not purchase a subscription.
test_queued: 测试已排队，请查看微信和下方发送记录。
Test queued. Check WeChat and the activity log below.
test_help: 测试会使用一次发送额度，每小时最多测试 3 次。
A test uses one request. Up to 3 tests are allowed per hour.
accepted_help: 服务已接收表示 Server 酱已接受请求，请以微信实际收到为准。待确认预约的暂时失败会自动重试，不因超过 24 小时而放弃；预约处理后停止旧提醒。测试及取消提醒保留 24 小时有效期。

Accepted means ServerChan acknowledged the request. Check WeChat for delivery. Temporary failures for pending reservations are retried beyond 24 hours; old alerts stop once the reservation is handled. Test and cancellation alerts expire after 24 hours.
usage: 最近 24 小时已请求 {v0} / {v1} 次
not_enabled: 创建提醒时未开启微信通知。
WeChat alerts were not enabled when this event occurred.
superseded: 预约状态已更新，不再发送旧提醒。
Reservation status changed; the old alert is no longer needed.
local_quota: 已达到发送额度，稍后重试。
provider_quota: Server 酱限制了发送，稍后重试。
provider_rejected: Server 酱未接受请求，请检查密钥和微信接收渠道。
ServerChan rejected the request. Check the key and WeChat receiving channel.
network_error: 暂时无法连接 Server 酱。
worker_error: 提醒暂未发出，系统会重试。
The alert could not be sent yet. It will be retried.
retry_exhausted: 多次重试仍未成功，请检查连接设置。
Repeated attempts failed. Check the connection settings.
notification_settings_invalid: 请选择有效的提醒设置。
notification_key_invalid: 请填写 Server 酱 Turbo 的 SCT 开头密钥。
Enter a ServerChan Turbo key beginning with SCT.
notification_not_configured: 请先保存 SendKey 并开启微信提醒。
Save a SendKey and enable WeChat alerts first.
notification_test_limit: 本小时已测试 3 次，请稍后再试。
Three tests have been requested this hour. Try again later.
notification_not_retryable: 这条提醒已发送、过期或达到重试上限。
This alert was accepted, expired or reached its retry limit.
version_conflict: 设置已在其他窗口更新，请刷新后再保存。
Settings changed in another window. Refresh before saving.
generic_error: Could not complete the action. Please try again.
message_created: 小狗拼豆铺 · 新预约待确认
message_cancelled: 小狗拼豆铺 · 顾客取消预约
PinDou Puppy · Customer cancelled a reservation
message_test: 小狗拼豆铺 · 微信提醒测试
message_test_body: 这是一条店主提醒测试。看到这条消息，表示微信接收渠道已连通。没有创建或更改任何顾客预约。
This is a test of your owner alerts. Receiving it confirms the WeChat channel is working. No customer reservation was created or changed.
message_timezone: 以上为汉密尔顿当地时间。
All times are local to Hamilton, Ontario.
